newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler keeps up rise, hits new year high.
newsitem.headline: Daimler keeps up rise, hits new year high.

text.p: Shares in German industrial group Daimler-Benz AG reached a new year's high on Wednesday on follow-through buying after some investment houses repeated buy recommendations on the stock.
Daimler, an export-sensitive stock, was also boosted by a recovery in the dollar against the mark.
Daimler shares hit a new year's high at 98.10 marks before paring some gains to trade up 3.85 marks at 98 marks, with traders noting that Daimler shares have risen nearly 27 percent since July.
The broader 30-share DAX index was up 34.95 points at 2,769.25 points and just below an all-time high of 2,773.10 points reached earlier.
